changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE patient_procedure DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_procedure_status_enum;

ALTER TABLE patient_procedure ADD CONSTRAINT ck_procedure_status_enum CHECK ( status IN ( 'REQUESTED', 'STARTED', 'CANCELLED', 'COMPLETED', 'AWAITING_CONSENT', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'SUBMITTED', 'RETURNED_TO_BED', 'WAITING_PRE_AUTHORIZATION' ) );
